title: Inspecting topics and reading samples with AutoDiag
keywords: autodiag inspect topic topics sample read message delivery qos endpoints silent no data proof
text: dds-autodiag inspect /scan lists every publisher and subscriber of a topic with reliability, durability and history, and reports incompatible pairs. dds-autodiag sample /scan --reliability best_effort --timeout 5 waits for one real message using AutoDiag's own ros2 topic echo, not a subscriber you picked: receiving one proves delivery to that probe, a timeout tells you where to look next. The dashboard Topics tab (Read one sample), live pair check and the RViz panel Topic tab do the same; discovery alone never proves that data arrives.
